howto.text:
How to try it

• Press Play on the prototype, then click in the notes of “Review CS 489 lectures 10–14”.
• Type Markdown: **bold**, _italic_, `code`, [text](url), # and ## headings, - lists, 1. lists, - [ ] checklists, > quotes, ``` code blocks.
• ⌘B and ⌘I work on the selection or the word at the caret. Return continues a list; Return on an empty item ends it. Tab and ⇧Tab indent.
• Click a checklist box: it toggles the [ ] in the text, editing or not.
• Paste a link over selected text to link it. Paste rich text from a web page: it arrives as Markdown. ⌥⇧⌘V pastes plain.
• ⌘K completes the task, as everywhere. Press ? for every key.

n_edit.text:
One view, always rendered, edited where it is. The caret is in “retr|ieval”: only that word's ** show, faintly. A line's # or > shows while the caret is on it; a code block's fences while the caret is inside it.

At rest nothing shows but the text.

n_chk.text:
A box toggles [ ] ↔ [x] in the text, editing or not, without moving the caret. Outside editing it's its own undo step (“Check Item”).

In the list, a task with notes shows a quiet glyph right after its title; with a checklist, its count (2/5) instead.

n_links.text: Links: type [text](url), paste a URL over selected text, or paste a bare https:// address. A click opens; the address shows on hover. There's no link shortcut: ⌘K stays Complete.
